item.text: [{"task_id":"d47aa2ff","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    separator = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    added = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    removed = int(round(params['rule'][3]))","    gap = int(round(params['rule'][4]))","    axis = int(round(params['rule'][5]))","    if axis != 0 and axis != 1:","        return grid.copy()","    boundaries = np.argwhere(np.all(grid == separator, axis=axis)).flatten()","    if len(boundaries) == 0:","        return grid.copy()","    cut = int(boundaries[0])","    if axis == 0:","        before = grid[:, :cut].copy()","        after = grid[:, cut + gap:].copy()","    else:","        before = grid[:cut, :].copy()","        after = grid[cut + gap:, :].copy()","    if before.shape != after.shape:","        return grid.copy()","    result = before.copy()","    result[np.logical_and(before != background, after == background)] = removed","    result[np.logical_and(before == background, after != background)] = added","    return result"],"shapes":{"rule":[6]},"params":{"rule":[0,5,1,2,1,0]},"rationale":"The gray divider separates before and after panels.
